value.rationale: The smallest binary Cartesian cube with four Laplacian spectral levels is natural and structurally separates Hamming-distance propagation channels. For its exact continuous fractional heat, exponent two causes genuine positive-negative-positive reentry at opposite corners; distance-two recovery has a different, logarithmically enhanced Lambert scale. These exact finite-time boundaries and separated asymptotics go beyond eventual positivity, numerical sampling or prior four-path calculations.
